series_title: The Ancient World of Ice and Fire
episode_title: Before the Dragons: The Rise of Old Valyria
visual_cadence_rule: 30 images per minute (1 image every 2.0 seconds)
visual_style_standard: Adult cinematic physically realistic 3D historical reconstruction & live-action 65mm location cinematography (ARRI Alexa 65, Panavision Primo primes, Kodak Vision3 500T grade: warm sandstone highlights, deep cerulean Summer Sea, lush emerald pastures, muted volcanic stone)
visual_qc_note: First pass: six of ten frames passed and were uploaded to Drive folder 1C-0rzizehths1tSA0As1NXfVJRW81y0G, each Drive MD5 matching its local file. Four were rejected and await targeted rerenders: IMG0251 and IMG0256 rendered the elder shepherd's irises pale steel-blue rather than indigo-violet (IMG0256 also settling into a symmetrical heroic poster stance); IMG0254's iris study drifted to a heavily stubbled adult male face with no temple braids and a synthetic lens-like iris; IMG0255 drifted to a posed cast procession and gave the woman carrying the child a strong likeness of a known screen actress. Eye-colour wording is tightened for the rerenders so iris brightness and size are stated explicitly and the violet cannot wash out to grey at distance.

scenes.visual_beat: Low-angle vertical scale — two herdsmen dwarfed by a columnar basalt cliff
scenes.editorial_treatment: Static 2.0s theatrical hold; clean cut on narration beat.
scenes.qc_note: REJECTED: the elder shepherd's irises rendered pale steel-blue rather than indigo-violet, and both faces tipped so far back that the eyes barely read. Awaiting rerender.

scenes.visual_beat: Macro material study — hand-spun wool glowing like filament silver-gold
scenes.editorial_treatment: Static 2.0s theatrical hold; clean cut on narration beat.
scenes.qc_note: Approved: hands only, calloused with rawhide wrist wraps, hank catching hard low sun; fibre reads as pale silver-gold shading to platinum white. Interior is a thatched-roof croft-like room, acceptable as a roundhouse interior, though the thatch must not be read as the exterior roof type.

scenes.visual_beat: Intimate close-up — platinum-white coiled hair, seventy-year-old clan woman
scenes.editorial_treatment: Static 2.0s theatrical hold; clean cut on narration beat.
scenes.qc_note: Approved: pure bone-white hair with no grey or dye, deeply lined alabaster skin weathered ruddy, unmistakable violet iris crescent under a heavy lid, wholly unglamorous and unposed.

scenes.visual_beat: Extreme close-up iris study — lilac, pale indigo and amethyst
scenes.editorial_treatment: Static 2.0s theatrical hold; clean cut on narration beat.
scenes.qc_note: REJECTED: the model drifted to a heavily stubbled adult male face with a dense brow and no temple braids, contradicting the 24-year-old clean-shaven herdsman, and the iris read as a synthetic lens-like purple. Awaiting rerender.

scenes.qc_note: REJECTED: the frame drifted to a posed cast procession walking in line toward camera, and the woman carrying the child is a strong likeness of a known screen actress. Both are episode-level prohibitions. Awaiting rerender.

scenes.editorial_treatment: Static 2.0s theatrical hold; clean cut on narration beat.
scenes.qc_note: REJECTED: the elder shepherd's irises rendered pale blue-grey rather than indigo-violet, and the two-shot settled into a symmetrical heroic poster stance. Awaiting rerender.

scenes.qc_note: Approved: elder's silver hair and sheepskin soft in the near foreground, young face sharp with unmistakable violet eyes, temple braids lifted by wind, wattle fold behind.
